summary: TEN Holdings filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026 reporting two board/committee actions and a new buyback. The Board appointed Yee Won Hiew as director, effective immediately, filling the vacancy left by Randolph Wilson Jones III's May 8, 2026 departure; she joins Audit and Nominating/Corporate Governance Committees with a $10,000 annual retainer and a standard indemnification agreement. Separately, the Board terminated the March 2025 repurchase program and authorized a new up-to-$2 million buyback, via open-market, negotiated, or Rule 10b5-1/10b-18 transactions. Watch repurchase pace and any further board turnover.
